summary: Implemented the Tabs feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run, installed, or committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); clickable_ranges added to UnderlineBar before width, attaching @click range_clicked('<name>') metadata per span; Opacity now merges the blended color with style + blended so meta is preserved; the layout resolver was left unchanged because Edge already declares min_size. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, a new test in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with an empty __init__.py. Choices made where the spec was silent: duplicate names render the last tab per name, search uses single-character keys only, handled keys use prevent_default, Escape calls app.set_focus(None), the no-tabs path draws only the bar, and clickable span ends are exclusive. Not verified: no tests were run, and the rich 11 Style merge and adjust_line_length behavior were assumed from memory, so the underline, opacity, and tabs tests need to be run to confirm.
